partial_status_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_auto_campaign_details_automation_status ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (campaign_id, status, action_code, created_at DESC) WHERE (is_delete = false)

partial_status_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_details_delivery_cooldown ON public.auto_campaign_details USING btree (account_id, action_code, created_at DESC, input_data_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['thành công'::text, 'đã gửi'::text, 'đã nhận'::text, 'đã xem'::text, 'đã click'::text]))

partial_status_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_sms_input_data_campaign_status_schedule ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, status, schedule, created_at, id) WHERE (COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false)

partial_status_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_status ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (status) WHERE (is_delete = false)

partial_status_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_campaign_input_data_phone_carrier_status_schedule ON public.auto_campaign_input_data USING btree (campaign_id, phone_carrier, status, schedule) WHERE ((is_delete = false) AND (phone_carrier IS NOT NULL))
